candidates.statement: Order service returns HTTP 500 on POST /v1/orders, which the gateway surfaces as 502 on POST /v1/checkout. Traces and logs show every checkout failure is caused by an upstream 500 from order:8000, while gateway /readyz stays 200.
candidates.uncertainty: Root cause inside order (db, payment, inventory) is not established; only the order 500 propagation is observed.

report.explanation: Checkout 502s are consistently paired with order-service 500 responses in traces and logs; gateway health endpoints remain 200, so the gateway itself is healthy and the failure originates in the order dependency. Metrics show checkout 502s alongside some 200s. The specific internal fault in order is not yet evidenced.
